pages.text: The &6Artisan Bench&r. Not a crafting table. A bench. You can make your own: a crafting table, four iron and four &6Glimmer Crystals&r. Or Dorrin sells them. Fifteen hundred.
Right-click it. A tab for every skill, every recipe shown. Ingredients glow red if you're short. Click crafts one, shift-click crafts as many as you can afford. Materials in your backpacks count.
Some recipes need a skill level. Some need a collection tier. Upgrades keep your enchantments. Bring materials, I'll bring the opinions. Here's some iron for your first go.
